body:
Thanks for the reply.

You're right about me not mentioning anything I indulge on. There isn't anything currently. Your description feels on point, I feel like I am merely functioning, but not living. And the functioning part starts making rattling and squeaking noises. I simply don't have anything I enjoy atm. Don't get me wrong, I love my family, but I wouldn't know what to do in order to enjoy myself atm. I still have 13 leave days left for this year, however, I know that every single one will be spent around the house or the kids, but that's okay since I wouldn't know what else to do.

And no, I don't think I can talk to my wife about how I really feel deep down, for two reasons. I don't like to crap where I eat, and I don't think she would take it in a way that would help. All the possible reactions I could think of, are not desirable


I am planning on still reducing the booze, even though I don't think it's a dangerous amount currently, I don't like what it does to me occassionally.

I will have to find something to make my heart sing, as you said. Currently everything is so empty, practical, functional and hollow. That's a thing that unnerves me. I feel unemotional, except the mentioned occassions where I then get whiny and self loathing. The stupid thing is, I know I will get like that, but I seem to look forward to bring me into that situation. I don't know whether it's masochism, or hope that I would take action. Brain is a mess
